Implement the undeploy operation for singlenode (single JVM) streams, ensuring consistency with the strategy defined in the referenced PR.
Leverage Spring Boot profiles to back the stream repository with different backend strategies, such as in-memory for the local profile.
Design a modular architecture with clear interfaces for porting XD modules to s-c-s modules to facilitate migration.
Integrate counter metrics endpoints with existing monitoring systems like Micrometer for dashboard consumption.
assumptions: The software increment is part of a Spring Cloud Data Flow (s-c-d) project, with s-c-s referring to Spring Cloud Stream.
Development is performed by a single developer with expertise in Java, Spring Framework, and related technologies.
The environment includes Java 17+, necessary build tools, Docker, and development IDE.
The undeploy operation for singlenode is specifically for streams, as implied by the PR reference.
Screencast creation includes both technical development of the demo and content creation for recording.
All activities are estimated for sequential execution without parallelism, so efforts are additive.
Basic infrastructure and project setup are already in place, so efforts focus on feature implementation.
Dependency resolution will handle common conflicts, such as those involving Spring Data jars, as per the example.

Configure and set up the process to publish the s-c-d image to DockerHub for incremental pushes as per U3.
Develop the demo for firehose|counter pipe, record and edit a public screencast to demonstrate s-c-s and development experience as per U4.
Implement the undeploy operation for singlenode (single JVM) streams, aligning with the strategy from the referenced PR as per U5.
Add support for profiles in the core Admin application to enable different backend strategies for stream repository, such as in-memory for local profile as per U6.
Brainstorm and design the architectural foundation for porting XD modules to s-c-s modules, defining interfaces and base structures as per U7.
Implement endpoints to expose counter metrics for dashboard consumption, integrating with existing monitoring systems as per U8.
